outside_slab.note: die places it next to the slab (any free site); its pll_stream output is the die stream clock tree root

nets.clocks: pll_stream (u_ck) -> ck of every lane tile and of u_core (die clock tree); rst_stream -> rs of every tile (async assert, synchronised in each tile)
nets.lanes: lane tile lo_* / li_* / flt <-> u_core lo_* / li_* / flt bits of that lane: abutting faces at the same y (0.192-um gap)
nets.die: lane tile rx / tx / tf = the slab rX / tdX / tfX of its lane; u_core f_vm / ts / t_vm (S face) = the slab VM interface; chb pin tied 0 on lanes W0 / E0 (UCIe ACK timeout), 1 elsewhere

timing: every tile pin a flop (skid main / skid-valid flops, pin registers), forwarded clocks kept buffers
